## Description {#details}

<p>A utility class used to compute instruction encodings for a code region.</p>


<p>It provides a simple API to compute and return instruction encodings as strings. Encodings are cached internally for later usage.</p>


<p>Definition at line 34 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/mca/codeemitter-h">CodeEmitter.h</a>.</p>
